parts.label: (i)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Integrate by parts and reach $a\dfrac{\ln x}{x^2}+b\displaystyle\int\dfrac1x\dfrac1{x^2}\,dx$. [M1*]
Obtain $\pm\dfrac12\dfrac{\ln x}{x^2}\pm\displaystyle\int\dfrac1x\dfrac1{2x^2}\,dx$, or equivalent. [A1]
Complete integration correctly and obtain $-\dfrac{\ln x}{2x^2}-\dfrac1{4x^2}$, or equivalent. Condone without “$+C$”; ISW. [A1] Total 3.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Substitute limits correctly in an expression of the form $a\dfrac{\ln x}{x^2}+\dfrac b{x^2}$, or equivalent; e.g. $-\dfrac18\ln2-\dfrac1{16}+\dfrac14$. [M1(dep*)]
Obtain the given answer following full and exact working. The step $\ln2=\dfrac12\ln4$ or $2\ln2=\ln4$ needs to be clear. [A1] Total 2.
